Name: Hardcore YOLO
Author: Klowes9496
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Hardcore Mode for daredevils! 

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Set up [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
Highly customizable configs, make standart runs or hardcore, your choice! 
1.5x more energy loss
1.2x damage loss
1.5x less friendship points gained
1.5x more friendship delay
Of course, all these numbers are customizabe, alongiside being able to choose if a run will get deleted or not if you lose.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[u]Client[/u] [u]Side[/u] mod, no conflicts.
Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
Windows, MacOS and Linux[/*]
[*]All players have to have the mod for multiplayer.[/*]
[/list][b]Future Promises (Most likely)[/b]
Translation for more languages and better multiplayer mechanics, more customization.

Manifest.Name: Hardcore YOLO
Manifest.Description: Permadeath overhaul: die or pass out and the run is over, your save deletes itself and you get a stats screen. Faster energy drain, harder-hitting player damage, weaker/decaying friendship, mine monsters that can double-spawn recursively, and slower multiplayer bed regen. Fully configurable, with a Hardcore?/Normal toggle when creating a new farm.
